title: LlamaIndex has launched OpenDocRouter, a service that turns PDFs and images into text using any of ten AI models.
key_facts: LlamaIndex launched OpenDocRouter on 7 Oct 2026, a hosted service for document-to-markdown parsing.
It offers five frontier models (including Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-6 Luna) and five open-source models.
LlamaIndex's ParseBench page lists Claude Opus 5.5 at 84.20 overall and $48.82 per 1,000 pages.
GPT-6 Luna is listed at 71.34 overall and $0.80 per 1,000 pages.
Billing is per token; prepaid credits start from $25 with a 5% fee on each top-up.
The API accepts PDF, PNG and JPEG files through a POST /v1/parse endpoint.
quote_evidence: Claude Opus 5.5 is listed with an Overall score of 84.20, including 93.53 on Tables and 91.03 on Faithfulness, at $48.82 per 1,000 pages.
why_it_matters_hint: Organisations that digest large document piles can choose a model by cost and quality, but should test on their own pages.
notes: Unite.AI article partly AI-generated per its author bio; benchmark figures are LlamaIndex's own.
